name: image_fspecial3
expr: ha = fspecial3('average'); hav = fspecial3('average',[3 5 7]); hg = fspecial3('gaussian'); hga = fspecial3('gaussian',[3 3 3],[0.5 5 5]); he = fspecial3('ellipsoid'); he2 = fspecial3('ellipsoid',[2 3 4]); hl = fspecial3('laplacian'); hlg = fspecial3('laplacian',0.2,0.3); hlog = fspecial3('log'); hlv = fspecial3('log',[5 5 5],[1 1.5 2]); hpx = fspecial3('prewitt','X'); hpy = fspecial3('prewitt','Y'); hpz = fspecial3('prewitt','Z');
comment: MATLAB Image Toolbox fspecial3 — predefined 3-D filters, all documented branches. average: ones/prod, default [5 5 5]; size-vector form [3 5 7]. gaussian: separable anisotropic, normalised to sum 1; default [5 5 5] sigma 1, plus per-axis sigma [0.5 5 5] (sigma element 1->rows, 2->cols, 3->pages). ellipsoid: integer-grid mask {(dr/a)^2+(dc/b)^2+(dp/c)^2<=1}/count; default semiaxes 5 -> size 11^3 with 515 voxels; [2 3 4] -> size [5 7 9]. laplacian(gamma1,gamma2): 3x3x3, face=1-g1-g2, edge=g1/4, corner=g2/4, center=-6+3g1+4g2, sums to 0 (default g1=g2=0 -> classic -6/+1). log: Laplacian of (anisotropic) Gaussian, zero-mean, default sigma 1; isotropic + anisotropic [1 1.5 2] forms. prewitt: separable 3x3x3 gradient X/Y/Z. Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b (tol=1e-12). Octave 11.1.0 ships fspecial3 in the image package only (not loaded by default) -> reports N/A there.
